title: Using Actor Parameters/Stats for Conditional Beaches

posts.author: Jinx Adnix
posts.body:
Posting this here because it doesn't seem to exist anywhere else:
Event Editor -> Conditional Beach -> Page 4 -> Script
Code:
Eval: $gameActors.actor([actor number]).[parameter]
Yes we know about the other method, the one with the variables... Games that need to reference the condition of the player frequently can make a mess of that and you need to set the variable each time... Jinx cares a lot alright? That's not a bad thing.
